articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Integrated Distribution Auxiliary Power Supply Based on Flyback Converter
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of high voltage stress of the switching caused by the High DC input single-ended flyback converter and serious mutual influence between the multiple outputs of the single-ended flyback converter due to strong coupling, a dual-switch flyback converter and a full bridge are designed. The converter two-stage topology structure, in order to avoid the influence of the zero point of the right half plane of the continuous current mode, a type II feedback compensation network is used, the open-loop transfer function of the dual-switch flyback converter before and after compensation is calculated, and by applying Matlab provided Bode diagram analyzes its stability. After that, the closed-loop feedback system of the dual-switch flyback converter is built in the PSIM simulation environment to simulate the rationality of the design parameters. Finally, the stability of the closed-loop feedback system and the independence of the multi-channel power supply output are verified by experiments.

articleTitle: Correlation Analysis of 25-hydroxyvitamin D and Renal Function Parameters in Adults in Anning, Kunming
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: This study is to determine whether the levels of 25-hydroxyvitamin D(25(OH)D) relate with those of uric acid, urea and other metabolic indicators in adult physical examination data, in order to provide a basis for preventing kidney disease. Methods: We selected the physical examination data from Anning Hospital in Kunming City from 2019 to 2022, including a total of 3,673 individuals who underwent for 25(OH)D, uric acid, blood urea nitrogen, and Serum Creatinine testing. Based on their 25(OH)D levels, we divided the population into two groups. We investigated the differences in these indicators of renal function between the two groups and investigated the relationship between these factors and 25(OH)D. Results: The Wilcoxon rank-sum test revealed that the normal 25(OH)D group had markedly higher levels of UA, BUN, and SCr (P<0.01). Moreover, Levels of UA, BUN, and SCr increased with the increase of 25(OH)D. Correlation analysis showed that 25(OH)D levels were positively correlated with these renal function markers (UA: r=0.239, BUN: r=0.158,SCr:r=0.289, P<0.01), and there was a favorable correlation between age and these renal function markers (UA: r=0.036,BUN:r=0.170, SCr:r=0.118, P<0.01). In accordance with the findings of multiple linear regression models, 25(OH)D was a factor that affected UA and Scr measurement outcomes independently (P<0.01). More than half of the people in Anning have insufficient vitamin D. This study found that those early detection indicators of renal disease were significantly correlated with 25(OH)D. People with high levels of 25(OH)D also have relatively high levels of blood urea nitrogen, uric acid and serum creatinine. As age increased, so did the levels of uric acid rise.

articleTitle: Fault-Tolerant Control for A Class of Switched Nonlinear Systems with Actuator Faults
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: This article studies the fault-tolerant control (FTC) issue of a class of nonlinear switching systems with actuator faults. To estimate states that are not available, a high-gain observer is utilized to eliminate the influence of inaccurate estimation of nonlinear function on state estimation, which is difficult for traditional observers to achieve. The fault-tolerant controller proposed in this article is based on a backstepping design approach, which successfully addresses actuator faults and resists time-varying disturbances caused by faults. At the same time, the output signal is capable of tracking the desired output signal effectively. The switching strategy based on average dwell time (ADT), which is less conservative in practice, ensures the overall stability of the system and guarantees that all signals in the system are bound. The effectiveness of the presented approach is illustrated using the example of an electromagnetic suspension system.

articleTitle: A Study on the Application of optimized K-Means Algorithm in Intelligent Hospital Procurement Supplier Management
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: In the procurement supplier management system of intelligent hospitals, the K-means clustering algorithm is widely used for clustering analysis. However, the K-means algorithm is sensitive to the selection of initial clustering centers and may generate local optimal solutions or fall into local minima. So this research improved the traditional K-mean clustering algorithm by combining the effectiveness evaluation index of K-mean clustering algorithm with particle swarm algorithm. And on the basis of the improved K-mean clustering algorithm, this research designs the supplier selection method of raw material intelligent procurement system. The experimental results show that the improved K-mean clustering algorithm has the highest initial profile coefficient of 0.51, and its profile coefficient is the highest when the number of samples reaches 300, which is 0.79. The improved K-mean clustering algorithm’s initial Dunn’s index and its final Dunn’s index are higher than the other three comparative algorithms, which are 59 and 67, respectively, and its Calinski-Harabasz index is the highest on average at 37.6, ranging from 3.4 to 11.2 higher than the other three compared algorithms. The optimized K-mean clustering algorithm has a larger Calinski-Harabasz index, which indicates that the inter-cluster variance is larger, the intra-cluster variance is smaller, and the clustering results are relatively better. This study is effective for the design of intelligent hospital purchasing supplier management system based on optimized K-mean clustering algorithm, which can be used as a technical reference for the customer segmentation problem of clustering algorithm.

articleTitle: Model Calibration of Active Magnetic Bearing Using Deep Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: Active magnetic bearings (AMBs) have been widely used in rotating machinery owning to their numerous advantages including no friction and adjustable bearing dynamics. Calibration of AMB model parameters is of significant importance in control optimization, condition monitoring and fault diagnosis. Traditional calibration methods mostly based on sampling and statistical methods, which suffer from applicability and accuracy when applying to AMB. Therefore, this paper proposed an AMB model calibration method based on deep reinforcement learning. Calibration is modelled as a parameter tracking problem, the agent interacts with dynamic model to learn calibration strategies directly. Results showed that our method can accurately identify force-current factor of AMB with high robustness to model uncertainty and measurement noise. Main contributions include that model calibration was modeled as a Markov decision process (MDP), which does not require any labeled data and ground truth degradation parameters, and deep reinforcement learning was introduced to learn calibration strategy directly, guaranteeing high robustness and adaptability to different scenes.

articleTitle: The Design of a Speed Controller for Switched Reluctance Motor Based on Takagi-Sugeno Fuzzy Control
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: Switched reluctance motor (SRM) is nonlinear and coupled, so it is difficult to construct an accurate motor model and adopt the traditional linear system control strategy directly. In this paper, the Takagi-Sugeno (T-S) fuzzy model is proposed to describe SRM linear state space. A robust controller is designed according to the internal model principle. The state feedback control law is obtained, aiming to achieve the expected closed-loop poles. In terms of PWM control, the proposed control strategy can be applied to the SRM. The simulation results show that this method can track the desired angular velocity well, reduce the influence of external disturbances, and have good robustness in the case of parameter and load torque fluctuations.

articleTitle: Research on Visual-Inertial Odometry Methods for Aerial Payload Delivery Scenarios
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: The localization performance of aerial delivery system is crucial in specific payload delivery scenarios. Currently, the navigation system heavily relies on satellite navigation, but interference can compromise reliability. To solve this problem, a visual/inertial odometer method based on MSCKF algorithm is proposed for aerial delivery scenarios. The proposed method addresses the problem of long distance between ground feature points and uncertainty in depth estimation faced by aerial delivery missions, by designing a long-range monocular triangulation method based on a sliding window in the front-end of the visual/inertial system, which improves the efficiency of the algorithm while ensuring the accuracy of depth estimation in distant and large-scale scenarios. Furthermore, the unstable motion states of aerial delivery systems will result in rapid deterioration of visual/inertial odometry accuracy or even failure of the whole system. To solve the problem above, a covariance constraint method and an improved visual-inertial odometry based on the multiple state constraint Kalman filter are proposed, which is suitable for aerial delivery scenarios. The feasibility and accuracy of the proposed method are verified through comparative simulation experiments in simulated aerial delivery scenarios. The experimental results indicate that, compared with the classical S-MSCKF and VINS-Fusion algorithm, the proposed algorithm can work properly. In addition, when compared with the pure IMU dead reckoning method, the localization accuracy of the proposed method is improved by about 40%.

articleTitle: Research on the Quality Improvement of Art Design Professional Course Resources Based on Adaptive Recommendation Algorithm in Smart Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: To further improve the quality of learning resources obtained by art and design students during online learning, this paper proposes an adaptive learning resource recommendation method based on graph embedding and deep reinforcement learning. Among them, the recommendation method is constructed in the form of knowledge graph, and the recommendation quality is further improved by constructing the learner knowledge tracking model. The experimental results show that compared with other types of knowledge tracking models, the improved learner knowledge tracking model has higher prediction precision, and the evaluation index AUC reaches 0.859. Compared with other recommendation methods, the designed adaptive learning resource recommendation method based on graph embedding and deep reinforcement learning can recommend learning resources with higher quality, and its MAE and RMSE indexes are 0.799 and 1.118. Therefore, the designed learning resource recommendation method has good recommendation effect, and it can be applied to the quality improvement of art design professional course resources, which has high feasibility.

articleTitle: Research on Flight Test Evaluation Techniques for Unmanned Aircraft in Complex Environments
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: Currently, unmanned aircraft flight tests primarily focus on typical environments, but the adaptability of unmanned aircraft in complex environments plays a fundamental role in their operational use. This paper takes electronic reconnaissance unmanned aircraft as the research subject and decomposes the complex environment it faces into three categories: electromagnetic environment, meteorological environment, and geographical environment. We develop a method for constructing a framework for testing unmanned aircraft in complex environments, complete the planning of flight test subjects for the adaptability of unmanned aircraft in complex environments, and establish an evaluation technique for their adaptability. The research results indicate that the developed flight test technology for unmanned aircraft in complex environments can effectively assess their adaptability, which is crucial for subsequent unmanned aircraft testing, operational methods, and effectiveness research.

articleTitle: Research on Improved Semi-Supervised Learning Fault Diagnosis Based on SE Module
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: The diagnostic models based on deep learning often rely on a large amount of data. In practical cases, the fault data is usually difficult to obtain, leading to small sample problems. Moreover, the data without labels is easier to obtain than the labeled data, so the semi-supervised small sample learning method is more applicable. To solve this problem, an improved semi-supervised meta-learning fault diagnosis model based on the SE module is proposed. The addition of an SE module to encoders can improve the ability to extract effective features from limited data. Unlabeled samples are used to correct the original prototype to eliminate positional bias caused by limited data supported by labels. The experiments were divided into 4-way and 10-way tasks, and the experimental data were used in the data set provided by the Bearing Center of Case Western Reserve University (CWUR). The comparative experimental results show that the proposed method achieves good results in the fault diagnosis of small sample bearings.

articleTitle: CFD Design Optimization of a 2D Airfoil for Drag Minimization Using Parameterization Method of Mesh Motion
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: As Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) has been playing a more fundamental role in design optimization, a broad range of engineering fields have started to apply CFD as an approach to deal with optimization problems. CFD design optimization in Aerospace engineering mainly aims to modify aerodynamic shapes to obtain improved aerodynamic performances such as drag reduction and lift increasement of airfoil. This paper concentrates on conducting a design shape optimization for a two-dimensional NACA0012 airfoil to minimize drag by implementing CFD exercise, modeling and simulation of the 2D airfoil, as well as the parameterization process of mesh motion have been employing in the optimization process. CFD application is involved to carry out this paper, including establishment and simulation of the airfoil model, simulations were executed on the 2D airfoil at zero degree angle of attack (AOA) with different Reynolds numbers, and undertaking parameterization process of airfoil mesh deformation by Radial Basis Function (RBF) to seek optimal result., eventually achieved in finding optimum airfoil shapes at a range of Reynolds numbers with respect to minimal drags.

articleTitle: A Multi-objective Genetic Approach to Clustering with Solution Recommendation
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: Clustering, which attempts to partition data points into different clusters according to their features, is the most commonly used analysis method in data mining. Prototype-based clustering algorithms are widely used because of their simplicity and efficiency, but it is less effective for non-spherical distributions. Evolutionary algorithms are increasingly applied to improve the quality of partitioning solutions. However, firstly the existing prototype-based evolutionary clustering algorithms still have difficulty in giving unsupervised recommended solutions for complex distributions. Secondly, evolutionary clustering algorithms with complicated optimization process reduce the efficiency of the underlying clustering algorithm. Both of them seriously affect the general applicability of the prototype-based evolutionary clustering algorithms. In this paper, a novel prototype-based evolutionary clustering algorithm is proposed, which is valid for arbitrarily shaped datasets. In the proposed algorithm, a solution recommendation scheme that does not require a priori knowledge is developed and applied to preserve solution diversity and recommend a single solution. What’s more, a new cluster merging process is applied to promote population quality and accelerate convergence. To verify the effectiveness, experiments were conducted on different aspects of the proposed method using several artificial and real datasets. The results indicate that our algorithm is able to obtain suitable recommended solutions for spherical and non-spherical datasets and outperforms related clustering algorithms.

articleTitle: Robust and Accurate Multi-UAV Cooperative Semantic SLAM Leveraging Lightweight YOLO
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: Multi-UAV visual cooperative SLAM primarily uses cameras as sensors that work together to complete positioning and map generation. However, traditional SLAM systems are based on the assumption of a static environment and face problems of high computational load and poor robustness in dynamic environments. To address these issues, we propose a multi-UAV cooperative semantic SLAM system based on a lightweight You Only Look Once (YOLO) algorithm. First, we made lightweight improvements to the YOLO network with the aim of reducing the system’s computational resource consumption and generating semantic information in real time. Second, we proposed an improved feature point screening algorithm that uses object detection and geometric constraints. This algorithm integrates semantic information and geometric constraints to judge the motion state of the target, excluding the feature points of moving targets, thereby improving the robustness and positioning accuracy of the system and making it adaptable to dynamic environments. Finally, we tested and evaluated our approach on the KITTI, TUM, and EuRoc datasets. The experimental results show that our system outperforms current mainstream SLAM systems in terms of feature extraction and positioning accuracy, and has good robustness and real-time performance.

articleTitle: Construction and Application of Real-time Environmental Data Monitoring System of Commercial Housing Delivery based on Internet of Things Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: In contemporary society, people put forward higher requirements for the living environment of the house, and health comfort has become one of the important judgment bases for customers when buying a house. However, the current evaluation of health comfort is abstract and post-verified. Therefore, it’s extremely important to split and quantify indicators (light/temperature/pollutants, etc.) for health comfort, and monitoring indicators related to the indoor environment. This paper designs a real-time environment data monitoring system based on Internet of Things (IOT) technology for the completed commercial housing before delivery. The system consists of hardware and software, including data sensing part, subsystem integration end, wireless transmission network and display terminal. After the preliminary comparison and analysis of the real-time monitoring data of the indoor and outdoor environment of the completed commercial housing, it proves that the significant characteristics of the system include the characteristics of high degree of general degree, strong real -time and good stability. Besides, it is easy to be moved, which can enable people to better understand the comfort and health of the housing before the delivery of the housing. At the same time, the periodicity of the monitoring time and the universality of the system enable the system to be recycled, greatly reduce the cost, and have good commercial application value.

articleTitle: Study on Lightweight Design of 3-D Continuum Structure Based on Topology Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: Some key techniques are described on the bi-directional evolutionary structural optimization(BESO) algorithm of 3-D continuum structure stress optimization with volume constraints. A joint simulation framework is constructed based on BESO method and FEM (Finite Element Method). The framework can be used to realize the topology optimization for 3-D structure. An application case is studied on the topology optimization for the upright column of the heavy horizontal milling and boring machine, and get an optimized topology structure for a kind of 3-D hollow rectangle framework structure. Some critical model reconstruction principles after topology optimization, are put forward constructively, which include outcome-oriented, manufacturability, reliability and integration etc.

articleTitle: A Multiple Guidance Mode System for UAV Landing in Landing Zone
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that a carrier-based unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) using single guidance system cannot land precisely in landing zone, a multiple guidance mode system for landing at landing zone is proposed, which combines satellite guidance and computer vision guidance. In view of the fact that the precision of satellite guidance is not enough and the whole process of landing cannot be covered by visual guidance, a distance-based multiple guidance mode system is put forward. By making full use of the advantages of each method at different distances and avoiding its defects, the carrier-based UAV can descend to the desired position on the deck of a ship smoothly and safely.

articleTitle: Three-Dimensional Path Following Method for UAV with Time-varying Velocity
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: In this study, the three-dimensional path-following problem of Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) is considered in the case with time-varying velocity. The velocity is considered as an unknown function of time, but can measured at current moment. In order to remove the non-differentiable velocity function in the drift field of the affine system of UAV path coordinates, the technique of change of the independent variable is applied. After that, to design the path following control law, the new system is transformed into the canonical representation of the affine system. Then, the nonlinear feedback is directly used to get the stabilizing control in the canonical form of the system. In the end, numerical simulation results demonstrate that the UAV has precise path-following capabilities with high tracking accuracy by the proposed control approach.

articleTitle: Design of ADCF-based Online Learning Resource Recommendation System for Preschool Education
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: Online learning has emerged as a brand-new method of knowledge transfer as a result of the Internet and the field of education coming together due to the rapid development of information technology. The proliferation of online learning tools, particularly in the area of preschool education, gives pupils more learning opportunities but also creates issues with selection and learning effectiveness. The goal of this study is to develop an Attention-based Deep Collaborative Filtering (ADCF) preschool online learning resource recommendation system by combining the attention mechanism collaborative filtering algorithm and deep learning algorithm. This system will assist students in selecting the most appropriate online learning resources from a large pool of online learning course resources and increase learning effectiveness. The results show that the average scores of the experimental class’s curriculum paper, early childhood teaching activity design and kindergarten game creation were 94.58, 88.15 and 92.43, respectively, which were 6.10%, 7.63% and 1.97% higher compared with the control class’s average scores of 89.14, 81.90 and 90.64, respectively. This study has significant practical implications for enhancing the recommendation of online learning resources and raising the standard of preschool education, as can be seen in the conclusion.

articleTitle: Identification of Heme Ligand Binding Residues Based on Amino Acid Sequence Information
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: Heme is ubiquitous in humans, animals and plants, and has a variety of functions. Correctly identifying the binding site of heme is helpful to understand the mechanism of disease action related to it. It is of great biological significance for protein functional annotation, drug discovery, related disease intervention and improvement of human function.However, the binding sites of some hemoglobin are still unknown. In this paper, by analyzing the binding information of heme ligand and protein in Biolip database, by analyzing the information of heme binding residues and their adjacent residues, and considering the physicochemical and structural information of amino acid sequence, A multi-prediction method based on Fisher discriminant, position weight scoring matrix and discrete increment algorithm is proposed. The voting method achieves good results, and the total prediction accuracy ACC is 72.29% and MCC is 0.45.

articleTitle: Consttuction and optimization of Higher Education Management System Based on Data Mining Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: With the development of social informatization, educational informatization is also developing. At the stage of higher education, many colleges and universities have saved a lot of educational data, which poses new challenges to the educational management system of colleges and universities. Nowadays, traditional higher Education Management (abbreviated as EM for convenience) methods are still adopted, which neglect the shaping of students’ personalities and the satisfaction of emotional needs, and fail to comprehensively consider the differences in the problems encountered by different students in learning, growth, and social practice. This article was based on Data Mining (DM) technology to construct and optimize a higher EM system, aiming to use DM technology to construct and optimize an efficient EM system, so as to play its role in teaching, student management, employment, and other aspects, and promote the development of higher education. This article tested the satisfaction of higher EM systems using DM technology through experiments, and found that the average satisfaction score was 8.2 points. This indicated that the higher EM system based on DM technology could indeed have a good effect on the development of higher education.

articleTitle: Research on Cloud Platform Task Scheduling Optimization Based on Industrial Internet of Things and Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: To optimize the task scheduling process during data processing in the industrial Internet of Things, a multi-objective task scheduling strategy based on improved ant colony algorithm is proposed. Among them, the task scheduling in fog computing in industrial Internet is taken as the research object, the ant colony algorithm is taken as the basic task scheduling method, and the task scheduling effect is further improved by improving the algorithm. The simulation results show that compared with other types of task scheduling methods, the task scheduling strategy based on improved ant colony algorithm can further reduce the energy consumption of the task scheduling process on the basis of maintaining good task completion time and load balancing. Therefore, the designed strategy can be applied to practical industrial internet cloud platform task scheduling optimization, which has high feasibility.

articleTitle: Partial Domain Bearing Fault Diagnosis Method Based on Weighted Bi-Classifier
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: The investigation of bearing fault diagnosis is a crucial and pressing core technology in the advancement of rotating mechanical equipment, as well as a significant national strategic requirement. In the realm of fault diagnosis, domain adaptation techniques have been extensively employed to effectively address the challenge of aligning source and target domains with dissimilar data distributions. Nevertheless, prevailing approaches typically presume that the source and target domains possess identical health conditions. However, in industrial applications, the target domain frequently constitutes a subset of the source domain. In light of this issue, this research paper presents a novel unsupervised partial domain fault diagnosis approach. Firstly, it incorporates a hybrid convolutional block, which is a lightweight network structure, to enhance the receptive field through wide kernel convolution and extract global information from various states. Secondly, it employs a dual classifier structure and incorporates an adaptive source domain class weighting method to dynamically select the most pertinent classes for target domain prediction. Additionally, an enhanced local maximum mean square discrepancy is utilized: A proposed approach is presented to attain alignment, and the experimental analysis of multiple datasets under varying working conditions demonstrates that this method exhibits a high level of recognition accuracy when dealing with asymmetry within certain domain classes.

articleTitle: Pre-launch Fault Detection Based on Spatiotemporal Features of Multiple Test Cases
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: Fault diagnosis speed is crucial for the pre-launch fault detection of flight control systems. To save the time costs, test cases only acquire the corresponding signals of some pieces of equipment for different test tasks. Therefore, the fault detection model has difficulty in analyzing the unknown topology relationships of missing test points and hidden fault features. This study proposes a novel fault detection method based on a spatiotemporal feature extractor. The topological relationship between the test points in different test cases is analyzed by graph attention networks. The temporal correlations of dynamic spatial features are captured by a transformer encoder. The experimental results with the ground simulation platform verify the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on Trailing Cone Flight Test Tower Fly-by Calibration Method and Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: This research report mainly introduces the principles of the trailing cone system and shows the importance and necessity of the equipment in the flight test. At the same time, it also introduces the characteristics of the tower fly-by calibration method of the trailing cone system, such as its limitations and scope of application.This report also describes in detail how to carry out the tower fly-by flight test, from the test instrumental modification that is involved before the test flight, the design of the test points, the test planning, the flight test method that is used, and the specific mode of data analysis after the test flight, it also shows an example of the tower fly-by test results; at the end, a secondary analysis was carried out on the flight test results, from the influence of airtightness of the trailing cone system, the calibration of sensors, temperature inversion, crosswind to quantitative analysis of parameters and other aspects have been studied in detail.Finally, by summarizing the results of all the factors, it is proved that the main influencing factor of the results of the trailing cone tower fly-by calibration is the geometric height.

articleTitle: Research and Application of English Question Answering System Based on BiLSTM Model Under Heuristic Teaching Concept
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy and effectiveness of the named entity recognition model in the English question answering system, this paper proposes a BiLSTM named entity recognition model based on multi-head attention mechanism. Based on the classical named entity recognition model BILSTM-CRF, the model introduces multi-head attention mechanism for improvement, and it adopts parallel mode to combine BiLSTM and multi-head attention mechanism, thereby improving recognition effect of the model. Experimental results show that among models with four different combinations, the parallel combination BiLSTM-CRF-Attention model adopted has higher recognition accuracy, F1 value is 4.94% higher than that of the secondary model, and the recognition effect is better. Under the premise of parallel combination, the F1 value of the BiLSTM-CRF-Attention* named entity recognition model adding CPF layer and multi-head attention mechanism reaches 0.8942, which is 28.24%, 27.01%, and 9.53% higher than the model constructed based only on BiLSTM, the model built based on BiLSTM-CRF, and BiLSTM-CRF-Attention model introducing a single self-attention mechanism. As can be seen, the performance improvement effect is significant, which means the model is worthy of further research and promotion.

articleTitle: Intelligent Fault Detection of Transmission Line Insulator Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: Fault detection of missing insulator is critical to maintain the reliability, safety, and electrical performance of transmission lines. However, current methods generally have low accuracy and poor robustness for the images with complex background. Additionally, these methods require some shallow features and are unable to detect multiple faults. In this paper, we propose a method for fault detection of missing insulator based on deep learning. First of all, aerial images captured by unmanned aerial vehicles are collected and turned into the detection dataset using data augmentation. Secondly, an optimized network model is proposed for obtaining the locations of missing insulator faults with high accuracy. Eventually, the dataset is entered into the ultimate optimal network model for training and validation. Experimental results on the dataset with data augmentation indicate that our proposed method is more accurate than current methods for detecting missing insulator faults.

articleTitle: Early Detection of GNSS jamming Interference Based on Statistical Test in Receiver Non-satellite Channel
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: Due to the inherent vulnerability of GNSS and the increasing complexity of the electromagnetic environment in recent years, GNSS signals are facing a growing threat from types of jamming interference. Early detection of GNSS interference is crucial to provide timely warnings before degradation in navigation and positioning functions occurs. This paper presents a novel approach for GNSS jamming interference detection using the statistical analysis, while also the influence of Automatic Gain Control (AGC) on detection is analyzed. By comparing the similarities of mean value derived from signals under normal and potential jamming conditions, hypothesis testing is introduced to detect the presence of jamming. The detection results are evaluated on Continuous Wave (CW), Chirp, and Additive White Gaussian Noise (AWGN) jamming signals by a semi-physical simulation platform. The results demonstrate that the approach exhibits a high detection rate under low JSR conditions.

articleTitle: Research on Customized Development Technology of Substation Digital System for Scenario-Based Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: Digital transformation drives all-round changes in production methods, business processes and management structures in the power industry. Digital technology is a key force in serving the development of the energy industry and building new power systems. With the continuous development of substation digital technology and the stabilization of the digital platform, the demand for application development around equipment and businesses in substations is increasing and becoming more and more urgent. A business-oriented, scenario-based, simple, and efficient customized application development platform is particularly important. This article introduces and researches the background, value, architecture, key technologies, application scenario examples, etc. of customized application development technology. Research and explore new models of application development, accumulate reusable service components, accelerate the speed of customized application development, reduce the complexity of application development, and improve application development efficiency.

articleTitle: Radar Object Detection Using 3D-2D Encoder-Decoder Network
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: With the continuous development of autonomous driving technology, accurate 3D object detection in complex scenarios has garnered significant attention. Among commonly utilized sensors, radar is often considered a robust and cost-effective sensor that can operate effectively even in challenging lighting or adverse weather conditions. In this paper, we propose a 3D-2D encoder-decoder network for millimeter-wave radar object detection, which processes multiple chirps input from a single frame to extract the location and class of objects. Our extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed algorithm achieves better average recall and average precision than previous works in all testing scenarios, significantly improving real-time performance. Our code is available at: https://github.com/luffydo/3D-2DEncoder-Decoder-Network.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study in Transaction Data Augmentation Based on Fuzzy Set Theory for Association Rule Mining
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: Frequent item-sets are sparse in real life transaction datasets, and data prerecession including data augmentation skills are necessary in order to carry out efficient mining. For example, the raw data (e.g. Power Mart transaction data set) contained the data field of price (Numerical), where a keyboard of price USD ${\$}$29.1 was mapped to price level of low to middle (e.g. “L2M” = 1), and product type of “KB”. Adopting the mapping for association rule mining, the top frequent keyboards of low to middle price level generated had a very low support = 0.12. In this work, we adopted the proposed data augmentation to map a numerical price to fuzzy price levels, where the keyboard of price USD ${\$}$29.1 was described by the different price levels at the interval [0, 1] (e.g. “LOW”= 0.0, “L2M” = 1.0, “MID” = 0.2, “M2H” = 0.0, and “HIG” =0.0). The advantages of making use of fuzzy set theory lied in two aspects: firstly the ambiguity of the vague boundaries among different price levels were handled, and secondly the experimental results showed the effectiveness of the fuzzy logic (e.g. much larger sets of frequent item-sets were generated, and more association rules could be mined in data analysis). The experimental results showed that the no. of frequent item sets and no. of association rules both increased greatly. The trapezoidal and linear membership functions were chosen, based on market research, objective preference, as well as the Power Mart transaction data set.

articleTitle: Research on the Alarm Method of PHM of the Train
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: At present, the PIS (Passenger Information System) system of the high-speed EMU only realizes the real-time monitoring function of the electric bow video. When a bow spark, abnormal bow and foreign body impact, the PIS display will pop up a fault alarm information. After seeing the alarm information, the passenger personnel searched historical videos in the PIS system through the failure time. Because the staff needed manual retrieval, the video information of the critical moment of the fault was unable to obtain the critical moment of faults, resulting in the efficiency of obtaining and disposing of electrical bow faults in the obtaining and disposal of the maintenance and maintenance personnel. In order to solve the above problems, this article proposes a new method of alarm alarm by electric bow failure. After the PHM is subject to early warning and alarm, it will automatically save and push the videos before and after the alarm. Accurately and efficiently obtain the fault information and deal with it.

articleTitle: Deep Reinforcement Learning Bearing Fault Diagnosis Method Based on Improved Reward Function
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: In deep reinforcement learning, the traditional reward function is limited in the problem of multi-class sample imbalance. In this paper, an improved reward function based deep reinforcement learning bearing fault diagnosis method is proposed. Firstly, the method improves the definition of reward function, and introduces a weak punishment mechanism to deal with the situation where the diagnosis action is wrong but the fault label is similar. Then, the samples are divided by K-means clustering method, and the reward value is newly defined according to the Euclidean distance from the cluster center and the proportion of sample labels. This method makes the diagnostic model explore and learn more effectively, and can deal with multi-class classification tasks effectively. The experimental results show that the method achieves remarkable performance improvement in multi-class classification tasks, and improves the accuracy and recall rate.

articleTitle: A Fault Diagnosis Method of Quadrotor UAV Based on Self-attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: Due to the different flight actions of the quadrotor unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV), the distribution of condition monitoring data in time dimension is inconsistent. The data-driven diagnostic model is difficult to extract fault features, which reduces the diagnostic performance. In this paper, a fault diagnosis method for quadrotor UAV based on self-attention mechanism is proposed. The attention mechanism is used to extract the long-term dependence of the data in time dimension. Then, a convolution module is added for further feature extraction, which can improve the capability of fault feature extraction. Experimental results show that the accuracy of UAV fault diagnosis under multi-action flight reaches 98.81%, which verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Driver Recommendation Algorithm in Firm Vehicle Scheduling Management Platform
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: With the development of the manufacturing industry and the gradual improvement of highway infrastructure in our country, many manufacturing firms have to expand their markets, but no longer limited to the local market. With the expansion of the market, the difficulty of vehicle management of enterprises has risen sharply. One of the vehicle management problems faced by enterprises is the allocation of drivers. In actual production, the allocation of order drivers is often done by manual allocation, which will cause unreasonable allocation results due to some human subjective factors, thus causing losses to enterprises. Firms want to allocate orders and improve customer satisfaction by selecting the best drivers. For better recommendation, this paper uses machine learning and other technologies to study and design the driver evaluation formula, and realizes the driver recommendation function, and carries out simulation experiments to simulate and verify the algorithm used. Through the accurate recommendation of drivers, the distribution quality and efficiency of enterprises are higher, the probability of accidents and violations in the distribution process is reduced, the operating cost of enterprises is reduced, and more benefits are brought for enterprises.

articleTitle: Research on Rough Scene Matching Navigation Method Based on Semantic Bag of Words Model
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: This article presents a method for rough scene matching navigation method using semantic information under satellite denial conditions. In the task of scene matching navigation, the current methods still rely on algorithms that require the detection of point features or other geometric features in the images. These algorithms have high requirements for image illumination, color, and angles, leading to weak scene adaptability. In this paper, we first partition the reference image and use YOLOv8 to extract semantic features from each part and encode them to construct a semantic feature library for the reference image. We then detect and encode the semantic information from the images captured during actual flight trajectories. By comparing the semantic features of the captured images with those in the feature library, we obtain rough matching blocks. The experiments were conducted using images captured by drones and benchmark maps extracted from high-altitude remote sensing satellites. The results show that this method proposed has good matching speed, reliability, and scene adaptability, providing aerial vehicles with rapid rough positioning and navigation capabilities.

articleTitle: CWDCGAN-GP Fault Diagnosis Method for Rolling Bearing Under Imbalanced Sample Conditions
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: Difficulty in fault diagnosis of bearings under imbalanced sample conditions. Aiming at the problem of bearing fault diagnosis under unbalanced sample conditions, a rolling bearing fault diagnosis method based on the gradient penalty condition Wasserstein deep convolution generative adversarial network (CWDCGAN-GP) with convolutional block attention module (CBAM) attention mechanism and wide convolution kernel deep convolution neural network (WDCNN) is proposed. Firstly, fast fourier transform (FFT) is used for signal processing; Then, the preprocessed data set is input into the CWDCGAN-GP network for parameter adjustment, model training and signal generation; Finally, the original signal and the generated signal are input into the WDCNN network for parameter adjustment, model training and fault diagnosis. The experimental results show that the proposed model can significantly improve the prediction accuracy under the conditions of multiple sample imbalance ratios, and verify the superiority of CWDCGAN-GP model and WDCNN model in bearing fault diagnosis under sample imbalance conditions.

articleTitle: Application Business Information Interaction Bus Based on Micro Frontend Framework
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of unstable operation of the integrated business system built by applying micro front-end technology, which is caused by the lack of more precise unified information exchange control when the sub application initiates a request to the backend data base, an application business information exchange bus based on the micro front-end framework has been studied and implemented. This article provides a detailed introduction to the overall architecture of the application business information interaction bus based on the micro front-end framework, the registration method of sub applications on the bus, the request processing mechanism of the front-end application, the monitoring and control method of sub application operation, the management method of data interaction channels, and the method of orderly page loading and rendering. This improves the efficiency of data and information interaction between various sub applications and back-end data bases. It has effectively controlled the running status of sub applications and the interaction channels of front-end and back-end data in the integrated business system, greatly improving the operational stability of the integrated business system based on micro front-end technology.

articleTitle: Relationship Between Maternal Gestation Period and Hemoglobin Concentration in Anning District
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: Because of the close relationship between pregnancy complications and maternal hemoglobin concentration during pregnancy, this paper discusses the correlation between pregnancy weeks and maternal hemoglobin concentration during pregnancy. In this study, 17,163 subjects in Anning area were analyzed. Gestational weeks and hemoglobin concentration of pregnant female were recorded, and the subjects were divided into group A (2019) according to the detection years. Group B (2020); Group C (2021). The obtained data were analyzed by t test respectively to determine whether the two had statistical significance. Perason correlation analysis technology and binary logistics regression were used to analyze the correlation between hemoglobin concentration in pregnant mothers and the number of weeks of pregnancy. The number of anemia in pregnant female during pregnancy was 5.2%. According to Perason correlation analysis, there was a negative correlation between maternal hemoglobin concentration and gestational weeks among different groups. Through the binary logistics regression analysis, the hemoglobin concentration of pregnant mothers during pregnancy can be explained by the number of pregnant weeks. Conclusion: Hemoglobin concentration is of great significance to the physical and mental safety of pregnant female and infants, especially in the third trimester of pregnancy should be paid more attention to, timely and effective detection of anemia, can effectively protect the life safety of pregnant female and infants.

articleTitle: Algorithm for High-Dimensional Data Based on Comprehensible Deep Progressive Fuzzy Network
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: Aiming at the “dimension explosion” challenge of fuzzy systems in high-dimensional data processing, this paper proposes an algorithm of DPFS (Deep progressive fuzzy system), whose structure is the connection of many low-dimensional fuzzy systems. Through the comparison of experiments with different data sets, it is found that: 1. the algorithm retains the advantages of strong interpretability of the fuzzy system. 2. the DPFS algorithm, characterized by its progressive structure, exhibits a superiority of 7.9% over machine learning algorithms like BP and RBF. Moreover, it outperforms fuzzy system algorithms such as DNFS by more than 31.5% in terms of accuracy on the BF dataset. The research demonstrates that DPFS serves as an effective fuzzy system inference algorithm capable of effectively handling high-dimensional data, showcasing robust comprehensive capabilities.

articleTitle: Active Passive Hybrid Binocular Intelligent Detection System for New Energy Batteries
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: This paper introduces a new energy battery active-passive hybrid binocular intelligent inspection system, using structured light and laser line-scan instruments to acquire battery surface image information. Based on the existing 3D reconstruction technology, the active-passive hybrid binocular system is designed. In order to reduce the interference of multiple factors, the 3D measurement anti-interference technique is used. Then, the sub-pixel level binocular matching technique under non-focus is applied to improve the accuracy of binocular vision method and realize high precision 3D reconstruction. For the difficulty that the detection of new energy power battery in different scenes requires a large span of depth-of-field field of view, this system fine-tunes the VGG16 model and designs a super accurate convolution edge detection model based on VGG16. In order to cope with the situation that a single production line of power batteries may produce different kinds of batteries of different sizes from time to time, this system uses a parallel multi-scale network (HR-net) based image reconstruction CNN to design a self-directed learning model based on Convolutional Neural Network (CNN). Finally, this paper introduces the design and implementation of the active-passive hybrid binocular intelligent detection system for new energy batteries, which demonstrates the better application prospects of this system.

articleTitle: Visual Analysis of High Dam Based on Digital Twin Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: To solve the problem that high dams have high data dimension, high collection density and it is difficult for traditional data analysis methods to obtain effective information from large amounts of data in the construction of water conservancy projects, this paper puts forward a visualization analysis of high dams based on digital twin technology, which realizes the construction of virtual high dams and real-time feedback of virtual high dams to real high dams through the modeling and data reuse of Physical high dams.

articleTitle: A MPPT Algorithm for the Photovoltaic Array with Partial Shadow Based on Improved Cuckoo Search Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: In practical engineering applications, the output power of the photovoltaic arrays with partial shadow often exhibits multiple peaks, which is a challenge for traditional maximum power point tracking (MPPT) methods as they tend to converge to local minima. In this study, a simulation model of the photovoltaic array with partial shadow is established in MATLAB, and an improved cuckoo search algorithm is employed to track the maximum power point (MPP). With the adaptive and decay factors into the cuckoo search algorithm, the photovoltaic array realize faster and more efficient tracking of the MPP, particularly in the presence of partial shading, thereby enhancing its practical utility in engineering applications.

articleTitle: Influence of Magnetism on the Icing Processes of Water Droplets on Cold Surfaces
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: The formation of ice on aircraft has always been a serious problem, it can cause catastrophic failures and fatalities. Currently, there are a variety of methods designed to mitigate and combat this phenomenon, such as resistance heating, bleed air heating, pneumatic boots, etc., and new methods like superhydrophobic coatings are emerging as potential future anti-ice systems. This paper aims to study the influence of magnetism on the icing process; it is widely known that water is a polar molecule, so magnetism could have a significant influence, and perhaps, can be used as an anti-ice method, which is what this study pretends to demonstrate. This study uses a particular test method to demonstrate the influence of magnetism on the icing process, the test procedure is based on an initial dripping of water drop and a subsequent progressive lowering of the temperature through a thermoelectric heat pump, the result is also the freezing of the drop. In order to compare results with and without magnetic fields, neodymium plates have been used to generate the magnetic field. The test results show a positive, light, and notable influence of magnetism on the icing process, achieving a retarding effect on the formation of ice.

articleTitle: Spatial Prescribed Performance-based Carrier Landing Control for Aircraft under External Disturbances
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: In this work, the carrier landing control scheme is developed for the position loop of aircraft under air wake and deck motion. Specifically, the disturbance observer is employed to estimate the external disturbances caused by air wake and deck motion, and the tool of prescribed performance is employed to design the landing channel. Then, the carrier landing control design is provided under the dynamic surface control technique. Finally, the numerical simulation is carried out to prove that the proposed control scheme ensures the tracking precision for the carrier landing task even under air wake and deck motion.

articleTitle: Research on Crack Identification of Cement-Based Materials in Road and Bridge Construction Based on Image Processing Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: At present, there are a large number of road and bridge buildings in operation in China, but existing cement-based materials for road and bridge buildings often have many cracks, and traditional crack detection methods cannot meet the requirements of intelligent transportation. To address the above issues, a crack identification algorithm for cement-based materials based on transfer learning strategy and MobileNetV2 lightweight network is studied and designed. The research results show that the accuracy of the pre trained MobileNetV2 network has been improved by 1.23%, and the TOPI error rate has been reduced by 0.21%. Compared with the performance of mainstream algorithms, the proposed method has the highest accuracy rate of 99.03%, with a TOPI error rate of 3.72%, and a floating-point computation, access, and parameter count of 1.5GFLOPs, 3.1MB, and 3.3 million, respectively. In summary, the proposed method can effectively balance classification accuracy and computational efficiency, and is suitable for real-time recognition of road and bridge buildings.

articleTitle: Research on the Design of Intelligent Enrollment System for Open Universities
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: The Open University of China covers People’s Republic of China’s urban and rural areas, with its headquarters in Beijing and 45 provincial branches in each province, and more than 3500 learning centers were set up in different cities, counties and districts across the country. The Open University of China enrolls millions of students every year, students often ask questions about their majors, courses, and learning methods, and hope to receive responses from the university. The enrollment staff of each learning center not only need to answer relevant consultation questions during the student registration period, but also need to review the student registration application to confirm whether it meets the registration qualifications, usually requiring a significant investment of manpower costs. The large number of enrollment groups conflicts with the prescribed enrollment process and requirements, as well as limited staff and working hours. There is an urgent need to improve work efficiency and service quality through new technologies and applications. By building an intelligent enrollment system and developing applications such as intelligent question answering and intelligent push to traditional enrollment systems, students can achieve online self-service registration, personalized professional selection, intelligent review of student qualifications, and automatic circulation, while improving efficiency and standardizing the process to improve enrollment quality.

articleTitle: Parameter Estimation and Adaptive Nonlinear Dynamic Inversion Applied to Coordinated Turning Control
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: During the aircraft maneuvering at high angle of attack, the dynamic characteristics of the aircraft show strong coupling and highly nonlinear characteristics with the uncertainty of aerodynamic parameters. The traditional NDI (Nonlinear Dynamic Inversion) control method is highly dependent on the model, although it can improve the nonlinearity of models and the dynamic decoupling. When there are parameter uncertainties in the aircraft model, the response of attitude angle (such as angle of attack, sideslip angle and roll angle) and attitude angular velocity will oscillate to different degrees. Aiming at such problems, an adaptive NDI control method is proposed in this paper, and the NDI control laws and the aircraft attitude control are designed. The aircraft attitude control turned to two sub-loops method: fast loop and slow loop. In the fast loop, we introduce the uncertainty of aerodynamic parameters, and separate the parameters of the affine nonlinear model. Then based on the Lyapunov stability theory, the adaptive control law and the matrix of estimating uncertainty parameter are proposed. Finally on the published F-16 fighter model, the system convergence is verified through the simulation experiments.

articleTitle: Leveraging BERT-GRU Model for Drugs Interaction Relationship Extraction
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: In the medical field, drugs are often used in combination to improve their efficacy, but it is also common for drug interactions to produce adverse reactions that can put a patient’s health at risk and even cause serious side effects or toxic reactions. In order to minimise the risk of adverse reactions from drug interactions, doctors need to understand the properties of each drug and provide appropriate dosing instructions based on the patient’s individual circumstances. In order to allow physicians to quickly extract drug-drug relationships, drug-drug interaction relationship extraction techniques need to be studied and analysed to establish a medical drug information base to assist physicians in accessing important information about drug-drug relationships and avoiding adverse drug interactions. This paper proposes a new algorithm for drug interaction relationship extraction, with two main studies covering the following aspects: (1) To address the problems of multiple meanings of words in relationship extraction, high computational complexity, low training efficiency and low generalization ability, this paper proposes a new model BERT-GRU based on recurrent neural network and BERT. in order to eliminate the influence of Chinese word separation ambiguity on entity relationship classification, the BERT is introduced as an embedding layer to better obtain the contextual information of Chinese characters; then The long-distance dependencies of entities in the sentences are captured by gated loop units and output to the Sigmoid layer for classification, so as to obtain better entity relationship classification results. (2) By comparing and analysing the experimental results of the BERT-GRU model with other models, the BERT-GRU model showed better performance on the drug-interaction relationship extraction task, especially achieving higher F1 values for relationships of advice, mechanism and int types. The BERT-GRU model performed even better compared to several other common models. This suggests that the combination of BERT and GRU is very effective in the drug interaction relationship extraction task. In summary, through a series of experimental comparisons, the BERT-GRU model proposes in this paper can effectively solve the problems of inability to distinguish between polysemous words and low training efficiency, and provides a more effective method for drug interaction relationship extraction.

articleTitle: Large Language Models in Healthcare: A Review
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: This paper examines the potential of large language models (LLMs) in the healthcare sector, delving into their prospective applications, challenges, and future trajectories. LLMs have demonstrated encouraging results in various healthcare-related domains, including the development of clinical decision support systems, natural language processing in electronic health records, healthcare question/answer systems, and healthcare education. However, integrating these models into healthcare practice also raises several concerns, such as data privacy and security issues, the requirement for vast amounts of training data, model biases, and the limited interpretability of model predictions. Overcoming these hurdles necessitates a collaborative effort from experts across multiple disciplines. Despite these obstacles, the deployment of LLMs in healthcare holds the potential to transform the industry and significantly enhance patient outcomes.

articleTitle: Research on bearing fault diagnosis based on improved dense connection network
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: In the fault diagnosis of rolling bearings, a limited number of samples can lead to insufficient training of deep learning models, making it difficult to accurately diagnose the fault types in a timely manner. Data augmentation on one-dimensional vibration signals often suffers from issues such as generating non-intuitive and low-quality data, making it challenging to ensure model performance. To address the problem of small sample-based fault diagnosis in deep learning, this paper proposes a rolling bearing fault diagnosis method that combines conditional deep convolutional generative adversarial networks (cDCGAN) with an efficient dense connection network (Efficient Densenet). Firstly, vibration signals are transformed into two-dimensional grayscale images as input to the model. The sample data is fed into the conditional deep convolutional generative adversarial network, and the trained G generator is used to generate reliable new grayscale image samples to augment the original dataset, ensuring dataset diversity. Finally, the augmented dataset is input into the efficient dense connection network for fault diagnosis, and the diagnosis results are visualized to obtain a confusion matrix. The classical Case Western Reserve University dataset (CWRU) is used as the validation dataset, and a small sample of data is extracted for experiments. The experimental results demonstrate that the dataset augmented by the cDCGAN network can effectively improve the fault diagnosis performance of the model, achieving high accuracy even with a small sample size. Comparative experiments validate the enhancement of the proposed method on the model’s diagnostic capability.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Image Retrieval Algorithm Based on Convolutional Neural Network in the Innovative Practice of MG Animation
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: Animation industry, as an important part of cultural and creative industry, has been developed rapidly in recent years. However, how to efficiently and accurately retrieve and manage a large number of animation image resources is a major bottleneck restricting the innovative practice of MG animation. The study proposes an image retrieval algorithm framework based on convolutional neural network and principal component analysis to solve this problem. The framework aims to extract the deep features of images by CNN and use PCA for feature compression to improve the efficiency of image retrieval. Comparative experimental results show that the research proposed algorithm outperforms the common methods in 7 out of 11 buildings in terms of all-class average accuracy and retrieval time is within 2ms. The experimental results show that the proposed image retrieval algorithm not only makes significant progress in the accuracy and efficiency of image retrieval, but also demonstrates great potential for application in complex visual content scenes such as MG animation.

articleTitle: Fuzzy-synergetic Control of Course Keeping For USVs
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: Given that Unmanned Surface Vehicles (USVs) are nonlinear systems with significant inertia and time delays, robustness and dynamic performance are crucial for course control systems. Synergetic control theory is effective in addressing nonlinear control problems, but it involves adjusting numerous parameters. In this paper, we propose utilizing fuzzy theory to adjust the parameter settings of the controller based on the USV’s course angle, course angular velocity, member function, and fuzzy rules. Simulation experiments of the fuzzy-synergetic controller are conducted in MATLAB/Simulink and compared with synergetic controllers using different parameters. The experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of integrating synergetic control with fuzzy theory. Furthermore, the comparison results exhibit improved dynamic performance.

articleTitle: RMSA-Net: A 4D Radar Based Multi-Scale Attention Network for 3D Object Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: Perception is a fundamental task in autonomous driving systems(ADS) and robotic systems alike, which commonly uses multi-modal sensors including cameras, LiDAR, and radar. Recently, 4D radar has gained increasing attention thanks to its advantage of high angular resolution in both azimuth and elevation. As the unique features of 4D radar point clouds call for more efforts on brand new object detection algorithms based on 4D radar, there are few studies in this topic. Therefore, in this paper we fully consider the characteristics of the sparse and shapeless 4D radar point clouds and propose a model RMSA-Net to fuse rich contextual information and address the problem of height information loss. We conduct extensive experiments to demonstrate that our model achieves the gain in terms of 3D mAP and bird’s eye view(BEV) mAP by 3.28% and 0.96%, respectively.

articleTitle: Design of High Reliable Bus Communication for a Dual Redundancy Servo Control Driver
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: In servo control drivers with high reliability requirements, redundancy design is an important factor in ensuring system reliability, and a reasonable communication scheme is the key to maximizing the effectiveness of the redundancy channels. This article designs a communication scheme based on 1553B and FlexRay two-layer buses for a dual redundancy six channels servo control driver, and provides a detailed introduction to the ideas and protocol implementation of using FlexRay bus as secondary bus communication. The feasibility, real-time performance, and reliability of this communication scheme have been proven through communication testing on the FlexRay bus. This communication scheme provides a new idea for the redundancy design of highly reliable servo control drivers, and also provides a successful case for the application of Flexray bus protocol in the servo field.

articleTitle: Control System Design of Variable-span Morphing Aircraft Based on T-S Fuzzy Modeling
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: The problem of cooperative control of morphing aircraft during deformable flight is studied. The object is a morphing aircraft with retractable wings. Firstly, the characteristics of aerodynamic parameters varying with deformation are analyzed, and the longitudinal T-S fuzzy model is established. Then, combined with the robust $H_{\infty}$ control idea, and fuzzy Lyapunov function are adopted. Fuzzy Robust $H_{\infty}$ Control (FRHC) based on T-S fuzzy model is proposed. In the end, simulations verify that the model well describes motion characteristics of that nonlinear model within the flight envelope, and the proposed FRHC method guarantees the stability, robustness and tracking accuracy of deformation flight. CCS Concepts: Modeling methodologies, Model verification andvalidation, Nonlinear equations

articleTitle: Research on Improved Grey Wolf Optimization Algorithm Based on Random Walk in Task Scheduling of Cloud Computing Platform
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: With the development and widespread application of cloud computing platforms, efficient task scheduling has become the key to improving the performance and resource utilization of cloud computing systems. In order to improve the efficiency of task scheduling on cloud computing platforms, a simulation framework for task scheduling on cloud computing platforms is constructed, and the Grey Wolf optimization (GWO) algorithm is improved, combined with the Random Walk (RW) algorithm to optimize task scheduling on cloud computing platforms. The simulation results show that the maximum completion time of the research method is lower than that of GWO algorithm and RW algorithm. During the task completion process, the RWGWO algorithm has the lowest execution cost and the highest virtual machine resource utilization efficiency. When the number of virtual machines is 4, RWGWO has an average improvement of 12.33% and 5.12% compared to RW algorithm and GWO algorithm, respectively. The research method not only reduces the maximum completion time, but also reduces costs, which can effectively save cloud resources.

articleTitle: Urban AQI Prediction Using an Inverse Variance Weighted GCN and BiLSTM Combined Model
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: Forecasting air quality is very important for the development of effective environmental management policies. We propose a model that marries the strengths of a Graph Convolutional Network and a Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory Network. This model, further refined with inverse variance weight allocation, is designed to accurately delineate the spatiotemporal characteristics inherent in air pollution monitoring networks. This model takes into account factors such as geographical location, multiple pollutant types, and weather to achieve accurate prediction of urban AQI. First, we construct a topological structure graph that reflects the layout of urban air pollutant monitoring stations. This allows GCN to effectively capture the spatial characteristics. Then, considering that the historical data of pollutants is a nonlinear multivariate long time series, we utilize BiLSTM to effectively capture the temporal features. Finally, we leverage inverse variance to determine the fusion weights of GCN and BiLSTM. This results in the generation of spatiotemporal fusion prediction outcomes. Evaluation of the proposed model using air quality data from Chongqing shows that it has a higher level of prediction accuracy compared to other models.

articleTitle: Sparse Nonnegative Matrix Factorization based on Double Low-Rank and Sparse Matrix Factorization Model for Spectral Variability
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: To reduce the interference of complex imaging environment on spectral unmixing, we introduce a double low-rank and sparse matrix factorization model (LRSMD) (DLRSMD) to better characterize the intrinsic and variant endmember components in the scene, and propose a sparse NMF based on DLRSMD (DLRSNMF) by accounting for the sparsity of intrinsic and variant abundances. The sparsity of abundances not only satisfies the practical significance of abundances, but also effectively promotes the representation ability of endmembers. The experimental results also demonstrate the better performance of DLRSNMF, which can provide reliable endmembers and abundances.

articleTitle: Multi-Target Multi-Camera Tracking with Spatial-Temporal Network
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: Multi-Target Multi-Camera Tracking (MTMCT) aims to link objects of interest between frames and different camera views, which has many application potentials in the fields of surveillance and autonomous driving. Existing methods usually extract motion or appearance features from single-view trajectories to perform cross-view association, but struggle with camera view variations and occlusions. To this end, this paper proposes a novel method that integrates spatial-temporal cues for more robust cross-view matching. The proposed method firstly introduces a spatial-temporal trajectory selection module to enhancing feature saliency and reducing the impact of erroneous trajectories on feature matching and then extracts discriminative video-level appearance features for each trajectory with a temporal complementary learning network. Cross-view targets are finally associated by computing the cosine distances of the trajectory features. Experimental results on the public DIVOTrack dataset validate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Dynamic Obstacle Avoidance Path Planning of Unmanned Vehicle Based on Improved APF
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
